WiFi::State.desc: The current state of the WiFiManager.

values.name: Initializing
values.desc: The WiFiManager is initializing. Will transition to Initialized or Error state after initialization.

values.name: Initialized
values.desc: The WiFiManager is ready to be used, no STA or AP configured.

values.name: Error
values.desc: The WiFiManager is in an error state.

values.name: Connecting
values.desc: The WiFiManager is attempting to connect to an AP. Will transition to Connected or ConnectFailed state after attempting to connect.

values.name: Connected
values.desc: The WiFiManager is connected to an AP.

values.name: ConnectFailed
values.desc: The WiFiManager failed to connect to an AP.

values.name: Disconnecting
values.desc: The WiFiManager is disconnecting from an AP. Will transition to Initialized state after disconnecting.

values.name: Starting
values.desc: The WiFiManager is starting an AP. Will transition to Started or StartFailed state after attempting to start.

values.name: Started
values.desc: The WiFiManager has started an AP.

values.name: StartFailed
values.desc: The WiFiManager failed to start an AP.

values.name: Stopping
values.desc: The WiFiManager is stopping an AP. Will transition to Initialized state after stopping.

WiFi::State.name: WiFi::State

WiFi::Mode.desc: The current mode of the WiFiManager, deduced from the current state.

values.name: STA
values.desc: The WiFiManager is in Station mode. connecting, connected, or disconnecting from an AP (or in failure state).

values.name: AP
values.desc: The WiFiManager is in Access Point mode. Starting, started, or stopping his AP (or in failure state).

values.name: None
values.desc: The WiFiManager is in an unknown mode, in case of error or uninitialized state.
